description: Na₄PbGe₂S₆ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2 space group. There are four inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six S atoms to form NaS₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaS₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent PbS₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent PbS₆ octahedra, and edges with eight NaS₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 7-8°. There are two shorter (2.91 Å) and four longer (2.99 Å) Na-S bond lengths. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six S atoms to form NaS₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaS₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent PbS₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent PbS₆ octahedra, and edges with eight NaS₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 7-8°. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.91-3.00 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to six S atoms to form NaS₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaS₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent PbS₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent PbS₆ octahedra, and edges with eight NaS₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 6°. There are four shorter (2.91 Å) and two longer (3.08 Å) Na-S bond lengths. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded to six S atoms to form NaS₆ octahedra that share corners with six NaS₆ octahedra, edges with three equivalent PbS₆ octahedra, and edges with six NaS₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 6-8°. There are two shorter (3.04 Å) and four longer (3.05 Å) Na-S bond lengths. Pb is bonded to six S atoms to form PbS₆ octahedra that share corners with six NaS₆ octahedra and edges with nine NaS₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 6-8°. There are a spread of Pb-S bond distances ranging from 3.03-3.05 Å. Ge is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three S atoms. There is one shorter (2.24 Å) and two longer (2.25 Å) Ge-S bond lengths. There are three inequivalent S sites. In the first S site, S is bonded to four Na, one Pb, and one Ge atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing SNa₄GePb octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-89°. In the second S site, S is bonded to four Na, one Pb, and one Ge atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing SNa₄GePb octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-89°. In the third S site, S is bonded to four Na, one Pb, and one Ge atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing SNa₄GePb octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-89°.
